units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 308:3">Sifré Deut. 308</cite> <he>מְכַוְּונוֹ במעגילה</he> he tries to straighten the wood in a press; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 942:11">Yalk. Deut. 942</cite> (not <he>מכינן</he>); Pesik. Zutr. Haăz. (ed. Bub. V, p. 111) <he>נתנו לאומן שיְכַוְּונוֹ</he> he gave it to a mechanic to straighten it.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:5">Macc. II, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Makkot 9b:9">9ᵇ</cite>) <he>מְכַוְּונִין להן דרך וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ומְכוּוָּנוֹת להן דרכים</he>, v. infra) we make for them direct roads from one place of refuge to the other.

senses.gloss: to determine exactly (place, time &c.). Y. Erub. V, 22ᶜ לְכַוֵּין את הרוחות how to determine exactly the four cardinal points (v. רָבַע). Ib. bot. הארון היה מְכַוֵּין וכ׳ the Ark indicated for them the points of the compass.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="K00211"><he>כִּוּוּן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 10a:1">M. Kat. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>אין יכול לכַוֵּין אימרא וכ׳</he> is unable to sew the fringe accurately on the bosom of the shirt.
<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:8">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>לכַוֵּין אותה שעה</he> to seize the opportunity of just that moment; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (with לב or sub. לב) to direct or prepare one’s mind, to pay attention, to do a thing with an intention.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 2:1">Ber. II, 1</cite> <he>אם כ׳ לבו</he> if he (while reading in the Law) had his mind directed (to the Sh’ma); <cite ref="Berakhot 13a:23">ib. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>אם כ׳ לבו לקרות</he> it means, he read with attention (to the sense, not merely like one going over the text for correction).

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28b:2">R. Hash. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ לבו לצאת</he> he had the intention of complying with the law (v. <cite ref="J00515"><he>יָצָא</he></cite>); opp. (<he>כ׳</he>) <he>לשמוע</he> he directed his attention to listening, i.e. heard the sound with consciousness (but without devotion); v. <cite ref="K00213"><he>כַּוָּונָה</he></cite>.

Ber. V, 1 היו שוהין … כדי שיְכַוְּונוּ לבם וכ׳ tarried a while before prayer, in order to direct their hearts to their Father in heaven. Y. ib. II, 5ᵃ חזקה כִּוֵּין the presumption is that he read with attention; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְכוּוָּן, f. מְכוּוָּנָה, מְכוּוֶּנֶת; pl. מְכוּוָּנִים, … נִין; מְכוּוָּנוֹת

senses.gloss: in a line, corresponding. Y. Kil. V, beg. 30ᵇ עריס המכ׳ a straight bed of vines, opp. מעוקם.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מכ׳ הן</he> they (the vines) are in a straight line. Y. Ber. IV, 8ᶜ top <he>בית … מ׳ כנגד … של מעלן</he> the situation of the earthly Holy of Holies corresponds with that of the heavenly &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:5">Macc. II, 5</cite> <he>ומכוונות להן דרכים</he> (not … <he>נת</he>), v. supra.

<cite ref="Makkot 9b:18">Ib. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ומכוונות היו כמין וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>ומכוונין הן</he>) and they (the three towns on this side and those on the other side of the Jordan respectively) were in straight parallel lines like two rows in a vineyard; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 3:1">Toh. III, 1</cite> sq. <he>כביצה מ׳</he> exactly the quantity of an egg.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 7:6">Mikv. VII, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Chagigah 19a">Ḥag. 19ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 16a:8">Gitt. 16ᵃ</cite>
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to put in proper position, to prepare; to hold ready, to designate.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 2b:10">Bets. 2ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 16:5">Ex. XVI, 5</cite>) <he>חול מֵכִין לשבתוכ׳</he> a week day prepares for the Sabbath (that which has become ready for use on a week day may be used on the Sabbath), but a Holy Day does not prepare for the succeeding Sabbath, <he>ואין שבת מֵכִינָה ליו״ט</he> nor can the Sabbath prepare for a succeeding Holy Day, v. <cite ref="E00517"><he>הֲכָנָה</he></cite>.—

Meg. 12ᵇ (play on ממוכן, Esth. I, 14) כלום הֵכִינוּ וכ׳ have they (the Persians) arranged a table before thee?; Esth. R. to l. c. מי מֵכִין וכ׳ who arranges an altar &c.?; a. fr.—[Tosef. Maasr. I, 4 משיכינו ed. Zuck., Var. משייבינו, read: משיניצו.]—Part. pass. מוּכָן prepared, designated, ready.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:2">Bets. I, 2</cite> <he>עפר מ׳ מבעוד יום</he> dust (for covering the blood) made ready a day before.

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אפר כירה מ׳ הוא</he> ashes of the stove are considered ready (destined to be used for the purpose). Ib. III, 4 <he>אין זה מן המ׳</he> this is not among the things designated for use on the Holy Day. Ib. IV, 6.—Meg. l. c. (play on <cite ref="M01648"><he>ממוכן</he></cite>, v. supra) <he>שמ׳ לפורענות</he> he was ready for evil; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be made straight, to be remedied (cmp. תכן). Pesik. Zutr. l. c. אין אתם מִתְכַּוְּונִים אלא באור you (your crookedness) can be remedied only through fire; Sifré Deut. l. c. אין אתם הולכים אלא לאור; Yalk. Deut. l. c. הולכין אלא לאחור (corr. acc.).
to prepare one’s self. Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ (ref. to הִכּוֹן, Am. IV, 12) הִתְכַּוֵּון לקראת וכ׳ put thyself in proper condition to meet thy God.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">B. Kam. VIII, 1</cite> <he>עד שיהא מִתְכַּ יֵן</he> unless he did it with malicious intent.
<cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 3:10">Tosef. Naz. III, 10</cite> <he>לא נִתְכַּוַּונְתִּי אלא כמותה</he> my intention was to be exactly like her (as to her vow).
<cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 3:14">Ib. 14</cite> <he>מי שנ׳ לעלות וכ׳</he> if he who had the intention to eat the flesh of swine &c.; v. <cite ref="P00772"><he>עָלָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 22a:6">Sabb. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יִתְכַּוֵּין וכ׳</he> provided he has not the intention of making a groove.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 23a">Bets. 23ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דבר שאינו מִתְכַּ׳</he> a forbidden act which was produced without intent, i.e. an unintended but unavoidable effect of a permitted act.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28b:10">R. Hash. 28ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 53b">Pes. 53ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>שניהם … נִתְכַּוְּונוּ</he> both meant the same thing; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:7">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>מבקש לְכוֹנֵן עולמים</he> wanted to establish worlds.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:7">Ib.</cite> <he>על אלו אני מְכוֹנֵן וכ׳</he> upon those (the patriarchs) I will establish the world.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M01358"><he>מְכוֹנָן</he></cite>, f. <he>מְבוֹנֶנֶת</he>. Midr. Sam. ch. XVI (ref. to <he>הכינני</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 2:24">I Kings II, 24</cite>) <he>בזכות התורה המ׳ בארון</he> (the world exists) for the sake of the Law that is put up straight in the holy Ark.
